notes.title: New Update, featuring progress reset button plus extras!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, dear players![/h3]

I have some exciting news for you. I have just released a new update for the game that includes some features that you have been asking for. One of them is the [b]progress reset button[/b], which allows you to start over from scratch if you want to challenge yourself again. Another one is a bunch of [b]new fancy achievements[/b] that will reward you for your skills and dedication. And last but not least, I have added some [b]new levels[/b] for the core players who want more content and variety. I hope you enjoy these additions and have fun playing the game.

[b]I want to thank you all for your continuous support and feedback. You are the reason why I keep making games and improving them. You are awesome![/b]

notes.title: Bookmarks are saved when player abandons a level.
notes.content:
Small improvement - when player quits a level using X button, in attempt to restart it, the bookmarks now will be persisted.

Note that the full level progress will still be saved when you just close the game without leaving the level. To allow continue the level from where you have stopped.

notes.title: Item prices are now more affordable.
notes.content: I made item packs more accessible for ones who needs extra help. I halved the packs price, based on the latest feedback. Thank you.

notes.title: Major Casual Spider Solitaire update!
notes.content:
The epic Casual Spider Solitaire update with waaay more and easier levels, smoother gameplay experience and efficacious hints. You are now even getting an ability to skip a level if you are stuck.

Among improvements:
[list]
[*] new hint and skip items to help you learn and unstuck
[*] bookmarks - save your good base point and jump into experimentation
[*] save on exit - if you close the game, the level progress will be saved to continue it later
[*] bugfixes and optimizations
[/list]

That's a great news to the fans of the Spider Solitaire. So, what are you waiting for - enjoy your and share with your friends!
